svg.title: STFE 2027 Brand Guidelines — Photography art direction
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: — Well-lit modern halls, products and buyers
— Natural colour; no purple or orange filters
All images shown are illustrative visuals supplied by the organiser — not photographs of a previous STFE edition.
